snippets: function makeSprite(g,stage,key,initial){if(!/^(actor[123]|prop[123]|target|token[123])$/.test(key))throw Error(`Unknown sprite ${key}`);const node=el('img',{class:'sprite',src:`assets/${g.id}/${key}.png`,alt:'','aria-hidden':'true',draggable:'false'},stage);let props={};const update=p=>{Object.assign(props,p);const {x=50,y=50,width=20,height=20,rotation=0,opacity=1,scaleX=1,scaleY=1,z=1,filter=''}=props;Object.assign(node.style,{left:`${x}%`,top:`${y}%`,width:`${width}%`,height:`${height}%`,transform:`translate(-50%,-50%) rotate(${rotation}deg) scale(${scaleX},${scaleY})`,opacity:String(opacity),zIndex:String(z),filter});if(props.id)node.id=props.id;};update(initial);return{element:node,update,remove:()=>node.remove()};}
